description: Get a checklist: its target URL, instructions, run settings, every check (with the `id` update_checklist needs to edit one in place) and its 10 most recent runs. Call get_checklist_run with a run id for per-check results and evidence.

checklist_id.description: Checklist UUID, from list_checklists or create_checklist.

name: get_checklist

id.description: Check UUID; send it back in update_checklist to keep history.

instructions.description: How the actor exercises the product.

pass_threshold.description: Weighted score a run must reach to pass, in score_type's unit.

id.description: Run UUID; pass it to get_checklist_run for per-check results.

outcome.description: Verdict on the experience: 'passed', 'failed' or 'inconclusive'. Null until judged.

score.description: Weighted score, when there is one, in score_unit (a percent when that is null).

score_unit.description: Unit the run was scored in: null for a percent, else the points label.

status.description: Whether the run itself finished: 'pending', 'running', 'completed' or 'failed'.

run_mode.description: 'code' replays a recorded script; 'agentic' drives the agent every run.

score_bands.description: Labelled ranges of the score, or null when the checklist has none.

score_unit.description: What a points score counts; null reads as "points".

url.description: URL runs target: the checklist's own, else its project's address.

title: Get checklist
